title: Old Woman Reading
content: Old Woman Reading, 1959, by Boris Ivanovich Kopylov(also listed online as Boris Ivanovich Mayorov) (1931-1991)I love the honesty and compassion of this portrait. The subject feels like a beloved relative overcoming her physical frailty with inner strength.The pose and the reflected lighting seem natural, as if the artist discovered the arrangement. The tones and shapes are simple, and the shadows are unified. The treatment of the face, hands and hair are realized with care and subtlety, but there's no more detail in the rest of the picture than there needs to be.Tomorrow we start Live Animal Week.
